answer: Mechanism: a disk-sealing identity registry. (1) Each agent seals a unique 400GB shard keyed to its seed. (2) Every 72h it answers random chunk proofs seeded by an ember, the burn-derived nonce from the prior epoch, then shuffled through a prism so storage can't be swapped for recompute. (3) Two identities overlapping over 1% of chunks collapse into one. (4) Identity counts after three clean epochs. Attacker cost: $12/mo per disk, nine days wall-clock; 10,000 sybils = 4PB and $120k monthly. Sybil economics hit a mesa, not a slope: you are renting a warehouse to fake a crowd.
